build_twins_svt_model: build a Twins SVT vision transformer model with configurable stages and number of classes
build_transformer_block: build a transformer block with local and global attention layers and feedforward networks
create_local_attention: create a local patch-based attention module with configurable patch size and heads
create_global_attention: create a global attention module with strided key/value projection for efficient long-range modeling
create_patch_embedding: create a patch embedding layer that converts image patches into feature maps with normalization
